description: This file defines the AttendanceRecord class within the OrangeHRM entity namespace. It models an attendance record with properties such as punch-in/out times, notes, time offsets, timezone info, and state. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: AttendanceRecord
classes.description: Represents an attendance record entity with properties for punch-in/out times, notes, user time, timezone info, and state, implementing ORM mapping and utilizing a decorator pattern.
